knowledge.title: Wave Bots app: what each tab does
knowledge.text:
WAVE BOTS APP: WHAT EACH TAB DOES
Info: name, model, personality (voice), About (what it's for), Add to desktop, Pin to sidebar. App-only fields: changing them costs nothing.
Cards: the bot's knowledge cards. Each card is one topic. Status chips show Minted, Shared, Saved (not minted yet) or Changed.
Customize: the 20x20 pixel mascot, its color, thinking face and idle motion. A recipe can ask the app to draw it (color + glyph) or to dream one with Wave Genesis from a .theta name.
Rules: who can chat (public or private), free answers per user per day, daily max, hours and away message, actions.
Listing: one-line pitch, category, up to 8 tags, the .theta name, engine. Listing in the bots.theta store is optional; unlisted bots still work by name or link.
Publish: one button. It plans first (what's new, what's reused, exact TFUEL), then signs the cards, then points the name. Dry run is in the Run menu. Export recipe saves the bot as a recipe file.

knowledge.title: How to write good knowledge cards
knowledge.text:
HOW TO WRITE GOOD KNOWLEDGE CARDS
One topic per card. Title says the topic. 2,200 bytes or less.
Facts, not filler: short sentences, numbers as numbers, dates with a year.
Only from the user's notes or sources. If a fact came from a source, end the card with: SOURCE: <url or document>.
Unknown or conflicting? Leave it out and list it for the user. Never guess.
No secrets, keys, passwords, private emails or phone numbers.
Split long material into several cards instead of cutting facts.
The "how I work" card is the bot's job description: what it does, its voice, what it returns, and its rules (what it must never do).
Cards are permanent once minted. Edits create a new version that replaces the old one.

knowledge.title: After the recipe: next steps and which bot helps
knowledge.text:
AFTER THE RECIPE: NEXT STEPS
1. Save the JSON as <slug>.botrecipe.json.
2. Wave OS > Bots > New bot > Import recipe (file or URL). Read the import summary and fix anything Validate lists.
3. Customize: check the mascot and color.
4. Publish > Dry run: free. Shows each card as new or reused and the exact TFUEL. New cards usually cost about 1.4-2.1 TFUEL each; reused cards are free.
5. Publish: sign the cards, then the name step (the .theta name must exist and be yours).
6. Live check, then try it: chat a few questions that its cards should answer.
7. Optional: list it in the bots.theta store, pin it, or add it to a Cascade.
WHICH BOT HELPS NEXT
Long PDFs or notes: Reader turns them into clean facts first.
A website or doc set: Wave Card Scout drafts cards from it.
Not sure the idea holds up: Critic argues against it.
Cards match their sources? Checker grades them.
Pitch or About need polish: Scribe.
Launch timeline: Planner. TFUEL budget: Tally. Part of a bigger project: CHIEF picks the team.
